title: ToolGateEnvelope
description: The pre-tool / post-tool governance envelope for one gated action (binder ch18 Work Order C5; ADR-0095 §5 'Tool preflight decision' command row). A pre-tool envelope is the ONLY point at which a block-tier action can be stopped with zero side effects; a post-tool envelope records tool-result persistence for actions that ran. Invariant (governance-invariants.mjs): a pre-tool envelope with tier block and decision proceeded is a contradiction — if it proceeded, the gate did not block. Verdict maps to decision: allow→proceeded, deny→denied, require-approval→held, rewrite→rewritten. Renders into the transcript timeline as governance-family TranscriptEvents (tool_preflight, tool_denied, approval_request).

actionName.description: The governed action, e.g. "git reset --hard", "rm -rf outside workspace root".

command.description: The raw command/tool input as proposed, verbatim. Null when the surface is not command-shaped.

tier.description: block = denied automatically; approve = held for a human gate; allow = proceeds without a gate. A tier is a property of the action, not the caller.

verdict.description: The preflight command outcome per ADR-0095 §5. Denial is a durable event, never a silent no-op.

reason.description: Why the gate decided this — required in practice for denied/held.

gateIntegrity.description: Honest gate posture. missing-hook / forged-compliance mean the gate failed closed because pre-side-effect enforcement could not be guaranteed; post-hoc-observation means the action was only seen after it ran.

transcriptEventIds.description: The governance TranscriptEvents this envelope rendered into. A gated decision with no transcript event is invisible and fails the C5 acceptance gate.

denialReceiptId.description: Set when decision is denied — links the durable DenialReceipt.

humanGateId.description: Set when decision is held — links the HumanGatePayload awaiting review.
